title: Website — YouCoded Light, Home and Finance

steps.headline: The website’s default look now matches YouCoded Light.
steps.changed: The page uses the new lavender YouCoded palette, wallpaper, Outfit text and glass mascot. The intro still cycles through Useful, Fun and Yours.
steps.notice: The page and current app preview settle on the same look. The headline and tagline you just approved are unchanged.

steps.headline: The phone preview starts in the same new theme.
steps.changed: The waiting picture is regenerated from the updated app, in YouCoded Light. The demo entry identifies its data as samples.
steps.notice: The page stays readable at phone width; starting the demo does not switch to a different-looking app.

steps.headline: Home opens a fictional household with working sample controls.
steps.changed: The existing Home Assistant page is pinned at the top and populated with fictional rooms, devices and state.
steps.notice: Visitors can try lights and temperature controls without connecting a home. Reference: the app’s existing connected Home page.
steps.risk: These controls simulate a connection; they do not operate real devices.

steps.headline: Finance makes the everything-app idea visible with sample accounts and spending.
steps.changed: The existing Money dashboard is pinned as Finance, with fictional accounts, balances, bills and transactions.
steps.notice: Visitors can explore the dashboard without connecting a bank. Reference: the app’s existing Money page.
steps.risk: The financial figures are samples, not a live account feed.

steps.headline: Home remains usable at phone width.
steps.changed: The sample Home page uses the app’s existing narrow layout rather than shrinking a desktop screenshot.
steps.notice: Selecting a page from Pages now gives it the full phone width. The Pages button returns to the list; Back to chat returns to the conversation.

steps.headline: Finance uses its responsive dashboard on a phone.
steps.changed: The same sample accounts and spending views adapt to the app’s phone layout.
steps.notice: Visitors can inspect an everyday dashboard instead of reading tiny desktop-only figures.

steps.path: Start on chat → Home or Finance
steps.headline: Try both pinned pages, then return to the conversation.
steps.hint: Open Home and Finance from the top bar. Try a light or thermostat, browse spending, then use Back to chat. All data and actions are simulated.
steps.notice: Chat is still the first view, as selected. The current renderer provides the same page navigation, theme controls and layouts as the app.
steps.risk: This preview has a fake backend: it does not call an AI model, a bank or a smart home.
